label: Frozen shared-one-block path distribution to 256-state full-information fitted-Q policy - 33 exposures - exact log-wealth reward - 17.5 bps friction

transition.representation: for every one of 15 marginals concatenate all 32 component probabilities, all 32 learned component return values in bps, expectation, and entropy; append log causal scale

architecture.network: one GNGLU maps the complete frozen distribution to a shared 256-value state; one linear head emits post-rebalance Q-bar for every exposure

rl.reward: exact log wealth: rebalance friction plus passive holding return
rl.portfolioTransition: exact marked-exposure drift after each realized active return
rl.counterfactualActions: every historical transition supervises all 33 actions; no behavior-policy action extrapolation
rl.target: Double-Q action selection with Polyak target evaluation

selection.testPolicy: sealed until the best validation checkpoint is selected
